description:
One observation on one node at one time.

Two fields are GROUND TRUTH ONLY and must be stripped by service/redact.py
before any inference or decision code sees them: `cause`, and rows with
`observed=False`. This is the leakage boundary and it is worth more than any
model in the repo.

anomaly_score.description: output of the commodity per-stream detector. This is deliberately the whole of baseline arm A1. Improving it strengthens our own baseline for no gain — no lane spends time here.
anomaly_score.title: Anomaly Score

cause.description: GROUND TRUTH parent event_id. NEVER visible to inference/ or decision/.
cause.title: Cause

observed.description: False => ground truth only, invisible to the system
observed.title: Observed

t.description: seconds since scenario epoch; float, not datetime
t.title: T
